overview.en: The Qwen3-VL-Reranker-2B is a vision-language reranking model in the Qwen3 series. It produces relevance scores for query-document pairs across text and multimodal inputs, and is suitable for search, retrieval, and RAG pipelines. vLLM Ascend 0.9.2rc1 and higher supports this model.
overview.zh: Qwen3-VL-Reranker-2B 是 Qwen3 系列的视觉-语言重排序模型，为查询-文档对输出相关性分数，支持文本与多模态输入，适用于搜索、检索与 RAG 流水线。vLLM Ascend 0.9.2rc1 及以上版本支持该模型。

env_setup.container.A2.content.en:
You can use the official all-in-one Docker image to run `Qwen3-VL-Reranker-2B` directly.

**Docker Pull:**

```bash
docker pull quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:nightly-main
```

**Docker Run:**

```bash
export IMAGE=quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:nightly-main

docker run --rm \
    --name vllm-ascend \
    --shm-size=1g \
    --net=host \
    --privileged=true \
    --device /dev/davinci0 \
    --device /dev/davinci_manager \
    --device /dev/devmm_svm \
    --device /dev/hisi_hdc \
    -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
    -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/tools/hccn_tool:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/tools/hccn_tool \
    -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
    -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64/:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64/ \
    -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
    -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
    -v /root/.cache:/root/.cache \
    -it $IMAGE bash
```

After a successful docker run, you can verify the running container service by executing the `docker ps` command.

scenarios[0].steps[0].content.en:
Single-card pooling deployment on Atlas 800I A3, using the required official reranker chat template.

```bash
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-VL-Reranker-2B \
    --served-model-name Qwen/Qwen3-VL-Reranker-2B \
    --runner pooling \
    --hf_overrides '{"architectures": ["Qwen3VLForSequenceClassification"],"classifier_from_token": ["no", "yes"],"is_original_qwen3_reranker": true}' \
    --chat-template /vllm-workspace/vllm/examples/pooling/score/template/qwen3_vl_reranker.jinja \
    --port 8000 \
    --max-model-len {{max_model_len}}
```

> - `--chat-template` is required for correct query-document formatting. Use the template bundled in the official image or the same file from the vLLM repository.
> - `--max-model-len` represents the context length, which is the maximum value of the input plus output for a single request. Keep an explicit conservative value, such as 1024, to avoid excessive attention-mask allocation.
> - Replace `Qwen/Qwen3-VL-Reranker-2B` with your local weight directory if you pre-downloaded the model.
scenarios[0].steps[0].content.zh:
Atlas 800I A3 单卡 pooling 部署，使用模型必需的官方重排序对话模板。

```bash
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-VL-Reranker-2B \
    --served-model-name Qwen/Qwen3-VL-Reranker-2B \
    --runner pooling \
    --hf_overrides '{"architectures": ["Qwen3VLForSequenceClassification"],"classifier_from_token": ["no", "yes"],"is_original_qwen3_reranker": true}' \
    --chat-template /vllm-workspace/vllm/examples/pooling/score/template/qwen3_vl_reranker.jinja \
    --port 8000 \
    --max-model-len {{max_model_len}}
```

> - `--chat-template` 是正确格式化查询与文档的必需参数。请使用官方镜像内置模板或 vLLM 仓库中的同一文件。
> - `--max-model-len` 表示上下文长度，即单条请求输入与输出的最大 token 数。请显式设置保守值，例如 1024，以避免注意力掩存分配过大。
> - 如已提前下载权重，请将 `Qwen/Qwen3-VL-Reranker-2B` 替换为本地权重目录。

scenarios[1].steps[0].content.en:
Single-card pooling deployment, suitable for development, testing, and small-to-medium scale reranking scenarios.

```bash
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-VL-Reranker-2B \
    --served-model-name Qwen/Qwen3-VL-Reranker-2B \
    --runner pooling \
    --hf_overrides '{"architectures": ["Qwen3VLForSequenceClassification"],"classifier_from_token": ["no", "yes"],"is_original_qwen3_reranker": true}' \
    --chat-template /vllm-workspace/vllm/examples/pooling/score/template/qwen3_vl_reranker.jinja \
    --port 8000 \
    --max-model-len {{max_model_len}}
```

> - `--max-model-len` represents the context length, which is the maximum value of the input plus output for a single request. If automatic parsing resolves to a large context length, allocating this mask (O(max_model_len^2)) may exceed NPU memory and trigger OOM. Be sure to set an explicit and conservative value, such as 1024.
> - Replace `Qwen/Qwen3-VL-Reranker-2B` with your local weight directory if you pre-downloaded the model.
scenarios[1].steps[0].content.zh:
单卡 pooling 部署，适合开发、测试与中小规模重排序场景。

```bash
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-VL-Reranker-2B \
    --served-model-name Qwen/Qwen3-VL-Reranker-2B \

    --hf_overrides '{"architectures": ["Qwen3VLForSequenceClassification"],"classifier_from_token": ["no", "yes"],"is_original_qwen3_reranker": true}' \
    --chat-template /vllm-workspace/vllm/examples/pooling/score/template/qwen3_vl_reranker.jinja \

```

> - `--max-model-len` 表示上下文长度，即单条请求输入与输出的最大 token 数。若自动解析得到较大的上下文长度，分配该掩码（O(max_model_len^2)）可能超出 NPU 显存并导致 OOM。请务必显式设置保守值，例如 1024。
> - 如已提前下载权重，请将 `Qwen/Qwen3-VL-Reranker-2B` 替换为本地权重目录。

scenarios[2].steps[0].content.en:
Atlas 300I DUO single-node pooling deployment (TP=1).

```bash
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-VL-Reranker-2B \
    --served-model-name Qwen/Qwen3-VL-Reranker-2B \
    --runner pooling \
    --hf_overrides '{"architectures": ["Qwen3VLForSequenceClassification"],"classifier_from_token": ["no", "yes"],"is_original_qwen3_reranker": true}' \
    --chat-template /vllm-workspace/vllm/examples/pooling/score/template/qwen3_vl_reranker.jinja \
    --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_capture_sizes": [1024,512]}' \
    --additional-config '{"ascend_compilation_config": {"fuse_norm_quant": false}}' \
    --dtype float16 \
    --port 8000 \
    --max-model-len {{max_model_len}}
```

> - `--compilation-config`: For Atlas 300I DUO, due to limited hardware streams, the size of `cudagraph_capture_sizes` is restricted.
> - `--dtype float16` matches the Atlas 300I DUO inference execution path.
> - `--max-model-len`: if automatic parsing resolves to a large context length, allocating this mask (O(max_model_len^2)) may exceed NPU memory and trigger OOM. Be sure to set an explicit and conservative value, such as 1024.
scenarios[2].steps[0].content.zh:
Atlas 300I DUO 单节点 pooling 部署（TP=1）。

```bash
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-VL-Reranker-2B \
    --served-model-name Qwen/Qwen3-VL-Reranker-2B \
    --runner pooling \
    --hf_overrides '{"architectures": ["Qwen3VLForSequenceClassification"],"classifier_from_token": ["no", "yes"],"is_original_qwen3_reranker": true}' \
    --chat-template /vllm-workspace/vllm/examples/pooling/score/template/qwen3_vl_reranker.jinja \
    --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_capture_sizes": [1024,512]}' \
    --additional-config '{"ascend_compilation_config": {"fuse_norm_quant": false}}' \
    --dtype float16 \
    --port 8000 \
    --max-model-len {{max_model_len}}
```

> - `--compilation-config`：Atlas 300I DUO 受硬件流数量限制，需要限制 `cudagraph_capture_sizes` 的规模。
> - `--dtype float16`：与 Atlas 300I DUO 推理执行路径一致。
> - `--max-model-len`：若自动解析得到较大的上下文长度，分配该掩码（O(max_model_len^2)）可能超出 NPU 显存并导致 OOM。请务必显式设置保守值，例如 1024。

evaluation.accuracy.content.en:
### Using MTEB

Refer to [MTEB](https://docs.mteb.org/) for details.

Run the following code to execute the accuracy evaluation:

```python
import os

from mteb.models.vllm_wrapper import VllmCrossEncoderWrapper

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import mteb

    data_path = "/home/data/mteb_data"
    os.environ["HF_DATASETS_CACHE"] = data_path
    os.environ["HF_ENDPOINT"] = "https://hf-mirror.com"

    model = VllmCrossEncoderWrapper("/root/.cache/models/Qwen3-VL-Reranker-2B",
                                revision="norm",
                                dtype="float16",
                                enforce_eager=True,
                                max_model_len=1024,
                                hf_overrides={"architectures": ["Qwen3VLForSequenceClassification"],"classifier_from_token": ["no", "yes"],"is_original_qwen3_reranker": True})

    cache = mteb.ResultCache(data_path)
    tasks = mteb.get_tasks(
        task_types=["Reranking"],
        languages=["zho"]
    ) + mteb.get_tasks(tasks=["MultiLongDocReranking"])
    results = mteb.evaluate(model, tasks=tasks, cache=cache, overwrite_strategy="always")
    print(results)
```

After execution, you can get the evaluation result.

evaluation.performance.content.en:
### Using vLLM Benchmark

Run performance of `Qwen3-VL-Reranker-2B` as an example. Refer to [vllm benchmark](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/benchmarking/cli/) for more details.

Take the `serve` as an example. Run the code as follows:

```bash
vllm bench serve --model Qwen/Qwen3-VL-Reranker-2B --backend vllm-rerank --port 8000 --dataset-name random-rerank --endpoint /v1/rerank --random-input 200 --save-result --result-dir ./
```

After about several minutes, you can get the performance evaluation result.
evaluation.performance.content.zh:
### 使用 vLLM Benchmark

以 `Qwen3-VL-Reranker-2B` 的性能评测为例，详见 [vllm benchmark](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/benchmarking/cli/)。

以 `serve` 子命令为例，运行以下命令：

```bash
vllm bench serve --model Qwen/Qwen3-VL-Reranker-2B --backend vllm-rerank --port 8000 --dataset-name random-rerank --endpoint /v1/rerank --random-input 200 --save-result --result-dir ./
```

等待数分钟即可获得性能评测结果。
